package answer

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

type taskLookupContextKey string

const (
	taskLookupUserIDKey    taskLookupContextKey = "task_lookup_user_id"
	taskLookupAnswerIDKey  taskLookupContextKey = "task_lookup_answer_id"
	practiceTaskScopeKey   taskLookupContextKey = "task_lookup_practice_task_scope"
	publicContentAccessKey taskLookupContextKey = "task_lookup_public_content_access"
)

type publicContentAccess struct {
	relationID string
	userID     string
	role       string
	verified   sync.Map
}

type PracticeTaskScope struct {
	StudentPracticeTaskID string
	PartID                string
	MilestoneID           string
	LessonID              string
}

func WithTaskLookupContext(ctx context.Context, userID, answerID string) context.Context {
	if userID != "" {
		ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, taskLookupUserIDKey, userID)
	}
	if answerID != "" {
		ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, taskLookupAnswerIDKey, answerID)
	}
	return ctx
}

func TaskLookupUserIDFromContext(ctx context.Context) string {
	value, _ := ctx.Value(taskLookupUserIDKey).(string)
	return value
}

func TaskLookupAnswerIDFromContext(ctx context.Context) string {
	value, _ := ctx.Value(taskLookupAnswerIDKey).(string)
	return value
}

// WithPublicContentAccess marks a student-facing request that must pass the
// public ms-go-course visibility policy. A relation ID, when present, allows
// access only after ms-go-course verifies that exact semantic relation.
func WithPublicContentAccess(ctx context.Context, relationID string) context.Context {
	return WithPublicContentAccessAudience(ctx, relationID, "", "")
}

// WithPublicContentAccessAudience carries the authenticated audience to the
// public ms-go-course preflight without exposing the internal service token.
func WithPublicContentAccessAudience(ctx context.Context, relationID, userID, role string) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, publicContentAccessKey, &publicContentAccess{
		relationID: strings.TrimSpace(relationID),
		userID:     strings.TrimSpace(userID),
		role:       strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(role)),
	})
}

// PublicContentAccessFromContext reports whether public visibility must be
// checked and returns the optional semantic relation ID.
func PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx context.Context) (string, bool) {
	access, ok := ctx.Value(publicContentAccessKey).(*publicContentAccess)
	if !ok || access == nil {
		return "", false
	}
	return access.relationID, true
}

// PublicContentAudienceFromContext returns the authenticated user headers that
// must be forwarded to the public ms-go-course preflight.
func PublicContentAudienceFromContext(ctx context.Context) (string, string, bool) {
	access, ok := ctx.Value(publicContentAccessKey).(*publicContentAccess)
	if !ok || access == nil || access.userID == "" || access.role == "" {
		return "", "", false
	}
	return access.userID, access.role, true
}

// PublicContentAccessVerified avoids duplicate public preflight calls when a
// handler resolves access and then loads the same content metadata.
func PublicContentAccessVerified(ctx context.Context, kind, id string) bool {
	access, ok := ctx.Value(publicContentAccessKey).(*publicContentAccess)
	if !ok || access == nil {
		return false
	}
	_, verified := access.verified.Load(kind + ":" + id)
	return verified
}

// MarkPublicContentAccessVerified records a successful ms-go-course preflight
// for the lifetime of the current request context.
func MarkPublicContentAccessVerified(ctx context.Context, kind, id string) {
	access, ok := ctx.Value(publicContentAccessKey).(*publicContentAccess)
	if !ok || access == nil {
		return
	}
	access.verified.Store(kind+":"+id, struct{}{})
}

func WithPracticeTaskScope(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentPracticeTaskID, partID, milestoneID, lessonID string,
) context.Context {
	scope := PracticeTaskScope{
		StudentPracticeTaskID: studentPracticeTaskID,
		PartID:                partID,
		MilestoneID:           milestoneID,
		LessonID:              lessonID,
	}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, practiceTaskScopeKey, scope)
}

func PracticeTaskScopeFromContext(ctx context.Context) (PracticeTaskScope, bool) {
	scope, ok := ctx.Value(practiceTaskScopeKey).(PracticeTaskScope)
	if !ok {
		return PracticeTaskScope{}, false
	}
	if scope.StudentPracticeTaskID == "" || scope.PartID == "" || scope.MilestoneID == "" {
		return PracticeTaskScope{}, false
	}
	return scope, true
}
